title: Intrinsic Koszul completion
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site and constant coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, let $r\geq0$, let $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)\subseteq\Lambda$, and let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$. Assume the coefficient hypotheses of [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]: $\Lambda/I$ is torsion as an additive group and each $\Lambda/I^n$, $n\geq1$, in degree zero is perfect over $\Lambda$.

For $m\geq1$, let $Q_m=K(\Lambda;f_1^m,\ldots,f_r^m)$ be the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], reindexed by $Q_m^{-a}=K_a(\Lambda;f_1^m,\ldots,f_r^m)$, with the same differential, in cohomological degrees $[-r,0]$. Its transition $t_m:Q_{m+1}\to Q_m$ is the exterior-algebra map sending $e_j$ to $f_je_j$; equivalently it is the tensor product of the two-term maps with degree-zero component the identity and degree-minus-one component multiplication by $f_j$. Write $u_m:\Lambda[0]\to Q_m$ for the degree-zero identity map (the unit).

Fix a K-flat representative $C$ of $K$ using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], and let $M_m=C\otimes_{\Lambda_X}(Q_m)_X$, with the total tensor differential [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Here $(Q_m)_X$ denotes the complex of constant sheaves. Let $P=\prod_{m\geq1}M_m$ be the termwise product complex and let $s:P\to P$ have components $\operatorname{pr}_m s=(1_C\otimes t_m)\operatorname{pr}_{m+1}$. Countable products are exact on this site [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact], and their termwise products represent derived products [lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core]. Define the intrinsic Koszul completion, using this fixed complex model, by
$$K^{\wedge,\mathrm{Kos}}:=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:P\to P)[-1]=R\varprojlim_m(K\otimes^L_\Lambda(Q_m)_X).$$
The cone and shift are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; $R\varprojlim$ here denotes this specified cone model of the general derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], applied to the Koszul tower. Explicitly its degree-$a$ term is $P^{a-1}\oplus P^a$ with differential $(y,x)\mapsto(-d_Py-(1-s)x,d_Px)$.

Let $a:C\to P$ have components $c\mapsto c\otimes1$ induced by the units $u_m$. Define $\kappa_K:K\to K^{\wedge,\mathrm{Kos}}$ to be the derived class of the chain map $C\to\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$, $c\mapsto(0,a(c))$. Call $K$ intrinsically derived $I$-complete when $\kappa_K$ is an isomorphism; below, “derived $I$-complete” means this intrinsic condition.
